inline_comments: Detects governance parity gaps between enforcement surfaces (CLI, IDE, API). When organizations deploy governance policies, rules may be enforced differently depending on the surface. This checker identifies rules that only apply to some surfaces, highlighting enforcement gaps.
Analyze a set of policies for surface parity gaps.
Detect which surfaces a rule targets. Returns empty array for universal rules (no surface restriction).
Parse condition string for surface references
Check object-form conditions for surface keys
Find gaps by grouping surface-specific rules by their normalized semantics and checking which surfaces are missing counterparts.
Group by normalized key (action + non-surface conditions)
Only flag gaps if rule exists for some surfaces but not all
Generate a normalized key for a rule based on its semantics (action + non-surface conditions), so we can group rules that do the same thing on different surfaces.
Remove surface-related parts from a condition to get the "semantic core" of a rule for comparison purposes.
Remove surface == 'x' clauses and surrounding connectives
Compute a 0-100 parity score. 100 = perfect parity (all rules are universal or all surfaces equally covered). Deductions for each gap, weighted by severity.
